climate: Most rain falls in winter. Dry summers keep mildew and rot down, though young vines may need watering.

blurb.text: A small valley AVA straddling Napa and Solano counties, partly inside Napa Valley. Its southerly spot brings more sun, while San Pablo Bay keeps it cool, which suits Pinot Noir. It had only 73 acres under vine when created.
